**Extended Bloch group and the Cheeger–Chern–Simons class**

*Walter D Neumann*

62 pp, 20 sections.

**Abstract.** We deﬁne an extended Bloch group and show it is naturally isomorphic to H3(PSL(2, C)δ; Z). Using the Rogers dilogarithm function this leads to an ex- act simplicial formula for the universal Cheeger–Chern–Simons class on this homology group. It also leads to an independent proof of the analytic relation- ship between volume and Chern–Simons invariant of hyperbolic 3–manifolds conjectured in [16] and proved in [24], as well as eﬀective formulae for the Chern–Simons invariant of a hyperbolic 3–manifold.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 The extended Bloch group; 3 Parameters for ideal hyperbolic simplices; 4 Definition of; 4.1 Representing elements of Hn(G;Z); 4.1.1 Algebraic description; 4.1.2 Topological description; 5 Developing map; 6 The cycle relation; 7 Computation of B"0362B(C); 8 The more extended Bloch group; 9 Proof of Theorem ??; 10 Start of the proof of Theorem ??; 11 Completion of proof of Theorem ??; 12 Cheeger--Chern--Simons class; 13 Unordered simplices; 14 Invariants of 3--manifolds
